description: Export your session's saved offer, proposed plan or explicitly incomplete response without inference. Large responses use the agent's resumable manifest; retrieve each indexed part with get_export_part. An export is not publication or certification. Does not revise seller terms, but creates a metered asynchronous job and may retain delivery state.

inputSchema.description: Illustrative example identifiers must be replaced by IDs returned for your authenticated session; this schema does not dispatch the example.

format.description: Saved representation to export. Choose incomplete only for an explicitly unfinished record; export does not publish or authorize it.

request_id.description: Caller-generated UUID for this logical operation. Retain it and identical arguments for retries; do not reuse it for different work.

session_id.description: The isolated session UUID returned by start_session; use the same client identity.

name: export_offer
